issues.on_page: Operating disbursements and project costs listed by object only (Auto and truck expense, Salaries, ...)
issues.issue: Rules say spending listed only by object takes the fund's function and adds review 'listed by object'; the 25 object-only lines have no review flag. The function category itself is reasonable for an NRD.
Auto and truck expense may include vehicle repairs and insurance as well as fuel; defensible, but a judgment call.
Cost of sales fits goods bought for resale (e.g. trees/seedlings), but this category's label is aimed at utilities; check it.
